title: ConceptMagicNoita
description: Proof of concept for implementing the Noita magic system in Minecraft.
body:
Hello!  
This mod is **just** a proof of concept of Magic system from the game _Noita_.  
Link to game -> [Steam page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/881100/Noita/)  

  

## What this mod adds?

### Around 57 spells:  
- 7 types od projectiles  
- 8 types of modifiers  
- and other minor spells

### Wand item:
- item to use magic  

### Key item:
- to save spells to Wand
- to get spells from Wand  

### Recipis List (Warning! very profesional):  
[Recipe List](https://drive.google.com/file/d/165a8RvtP6ZKgnudzBMasaJ-20EXIgJ3f/view?usp=sharing)

### Wand Editor Block:
- block to interact with wand and spells

## How to use?  
1. place down Wand Editor block.
2. open it.
3. put Wand in 28 slot. (bottom left)
4. put spells in slots 1-27.
5. to save spells, put key in 29 slot. (to get spells from wand, put key in 30 slot)
6. done.
7. Use LMB to use wand  .

**Now you are ready to use MAGIC!**

## Visual Explanation on how Wand Editor work

![Wand Editor: explanation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4e7dd7dfdf2a99c8e6ea8a80d0d255b68eaea24.png)

You can give me it -> https://forms.gle/BvYZUHurpC8t2HFN9  

## DISCLAIMER
DO NOT SPAWN TO MANY PROJECTILES, IT WILL **LAG**  
Try to not have more than 100 projectils at once, the more, the greater the risk that the game will start to lag
